[[Labour Party (UK)|Labour]] | after_party = No overall control }} The '''2022 Southend-on-Sea Borough Council election''' took place on 5 May 2022 to elect members to [[Southend-on-Sea Borough Council]] in [[Essex]], [[England]]. This was on the same day as other [[2022 United Kingdom local elections|local elections]] across the [[United Kingdom]].{{Cite web|url=https://www.southend.gov.uk/elections-registering-vote/election-results-1 |title=Election Results 2022 |access-date=6 May 2022 |work=Southend-on-Sea Borough Council}} The council is elected by thirds, so a single member was elected from all 17 wards to a term of four years. The seats elected at this election were last contested in [[2018 Southend-on-Sea Borough Council election|2018]].{{cite web |title=Election timetable in England
